message: The other day, I was trying to teach my kids about fire safety. I thought I was being all cool, showing them how to check the smoke alarms. But instead, they turned it into a game, running around the house pretending to be firefighters! 😄 It reminded me that teaching preparedness can be fun, especially when you let kids take the lead. So, we ended up creating our own escape plan together, complete with a silly dance for when the alarms go off. Who knew safety could be so entertaining? How do you make these lessons enjoyable for your little ones?
